subject: Access closure & legacy project ownership for departing IC
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Access closure & legacy project ownership for departing IC

Hi team,

Heads up — Rishi has handed in his resignation; his last day is 2026-09-21. Before that date we need a clear, auditable plan to:

- Revoke credentials and remove service account access (cloud console, CI/CD tokens, third-party integrations)
- Assign ownership for the three projects Rishi maintains (see attached inventory)
- Ensure there are no lingering secrets or cron jobs in his name

I've attached the preliminary inventory Rishi shared (legacy-project-inventory.pdf). Markus, can you own the revocation checklist and propose staged timings? Monica, can you own the project handoffs and update the ownership matrix?

Please keep this thread tight — include any external PMs only where necessary. I'll loop in HR separately for payroll and final paperwork.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Director, Engineering Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: legacy-project-inventory.pdf

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 10:05:00 -0700

On Tue, Sep 14, 2026 at 9:12 AM Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com> wrote:
> Heads up — Rishi has handed in his resignation; his last day is 2026-09-21.
> Before that date we need a clear, auditable plan to: revoke credentials, assign ownership, etc.

Thanks Laura — I'll take the revocation work. Quick notes / proposal:

1) Staged revocation (to avoid breaking services):
   - Day 1 (2026-09-22): disable user SSO + block new token issuance
   - Day 2 (2026-09-23): revoke non-prod keys and remove IAM roles from service accounts created in the last 18 months
   - Day 3 (2026-09-24): full production cred revocation after owners confirm handoffs

2) I need an inventory of: OAuth clients, service accounts, API keys in vault, and any long-lived CI tokens. Monica, can you confirm owners for the three repos so I have contacts to validate the final cutover?

3) I'll attach a credential-revocation-checklist.xlsx with suggested commands and audit steps.

Markus
Senior SRE
Redwood Inference

Attachment: credential-revocation-checklist.xlsx

- repo: offline-eval (owner -> Evelyn Hart)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 09:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Next steps (action items for you before 09/21)

Rishi — following up with concrete asks so we have a clean handoff and audit trail before your last day. Please complete the items below by EOD 09/20: 

1) Confirm outstanding PRs and either merge or reassign reviewers. Add a short note in each PR explaining why you are reassigning.
2) Export a list of any personal API keys/service accounts you created (give vault path or repo reference).
3) Leave a 1–2 page runbook for the telemetry-ingest flows (how to run, common failures, contact list).
4) Drop any personal machine names from our monitoring alerts (list any you need removed).

We will schedule a 30-minute handoff call on 09/20 at 11:00 AM PT with Monica, Mateo (if he has accepted), and Elaine (Acme). I'll send calendar invites after owners confirm.

If you have any concerns about timing or access to gather these artifacts, let me know today so we can adjust.

Thanks for handling this tidily — it helps with audit and security.

Laura Bennett
Director, Engineering Operations
Redwood Inference
